[[File:Comic_Tauntaun.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Tauntauns, a type of reptomammal]]
A '''reptomammal''' was a type of [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] [[Species/Legends|species]] the had evolved some [[Mammal/Legends|mammalian]] traits, such as live birth. Examples of reptomammals included [[Clawdite/Legends|Clawdites]], [[Rancor/Legends|rancors]], [[Tauntaun/Legends|tauntauns]], and [[Vurk/Legends|Vurks]].

==Biology and appearance==
Reptomammals were a type of reptile defined as reproducing through live birth like a mammal, rather than laying fertilized [[Egg/Legends|eggs]] like other true reptiles. Reptilian characteristics could include leathery or scaled skin, claws, slit-pupiled [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], or a forked tongue.<ref name="NEGAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref>

Clawdites had singular pregnancies and gave birth to live offspring. Rancors had thick skin, and although they were reptomammals, they laid clutches of two eggs at a time. They did not suckle their young, but they did care for them. Tauntauns were [[Endothermy|warm-blooded]] and commonly [[Hair/Legends|fur-covered]], with subspecies of scaly tauntauns that lacked fur and lived in the ice caves of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. [[Vurk/Legends|Vurks]] gave birth underwater.<ref name="NEGAS" />
